Name: Better Mystic Syrup
Author: LuJueyun
Description:
Drinking Mystic Syrup achieves multiple buffs.
When the Set Skill reaches level 10, you can use Mystic Syrup to craft Stardrop and StardropTea.
When the Set Skill reaches level 10, you can use Mystic Syrup and Dragontooth to craft Dragontooth Weapons.
When the Set Skill reaches level 10, you can use Mystic Syrup and Mixed Seeds to craft some special seeds.
Added some Mystic CookingRecipes.
Craft Mystic Tree Seed with less seeds.
Use GMCM to set Skills, BuffLevel,  BuffSecond and UseSeeds(Count).饮用神秘糖浆可获得多重增益。当套装技能达到10级时，您可以使用神秘糖浆制作星滴和星滴茶。当套装技能达到10级时，您可以使用神秘糖浆和龙牙制作龙牙武器。当套装技能达到10级时，你可以使用神秘糖浆和混合种子来制作一些特殊的种子。添加了一些神秘的烹饪食谱。用更少的种子制作神秘树种子。使用GMCM设置技能、BuffLevel、BuffSecond和使用种子（计数）。
